title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Run From The Police #2
description:
On June 22, 2021, a Kenosha County deputy was on patrol when he saw a Chevrolet suburban with an expired license plate. He attempted to pull the vehicle over but the driver allegedly fled at speeds of up to 100 mph. The driver lost control of his vehicle and crashed which ultimately lead to the deputy saving him from the burning car.
